notable_absence.finding: Confirms the billing.json finding directly: this page's own text uses 'Enterprise Support Plan' verbatim ('If you want to create a cluster with the Enterprise Support Plan, you must get an Activation ID') - matching one of the two previously-flagged variants and never introducing 'Enterprise Service Plan' or any third variant.

cross_component_finding: The free-tier-to-paid transition procedure requires the on-prem `cbbackupmgr` tool (a server/ CLI tool, not a Capella-native one) to migrate data between free and paid Capella clusters ('you must use the cbbackupmgr tool'). This is a second instance, alongside cloud/security/auditing.json's deferral to server/'s Audit Event Reference, of Capella docs pointing back to server/ tooling instead of defining Capella-native equivalents.
cross_product_finding: The credit-card path is capped at Basic/Developer Pro; only a Couchbase-Sales-issued Activation ID unlocks the Enterprise Support Plan - a purely commercial gate with no counterpart in server/'s edition model, reinforcing why requiresSupportPlan was kept distinct from requiresEdition.
